name: siga-pet
description: Sistema Integrado de Gestão para PetShop

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.migration:add: cd Backend && dotnet ef migrations add
scripts.migration:update: cd Backend && dotnet ef database update
scripts.migration:remove: cd Backend && dotnet ef migrations remove
scripts.db:update: cd Backend && dotnet ef database update
scripts.db:drop: cd Backend && dotnet ef database drop -f

author: Edu-2de
